description: What InternetData knows about one domain, from its latest snapshots rather than a live DNS query: whether it is registered, which DNS record types it has, the records themselves, the network announcing each address, the other domains on its first IPv4 address, its organization's IP ranges, whether it is a disposable email domain, what its home page says of itself and links to, and the domains whose home page redirects or links to it. Always read `coverage.note` before concluding anything from a field that is not in the result.

domain.description: The domain to look up, such as `example.com`.

name: lookup_domain

coverage.description: Which datasets this result covered. Read `note` before interpreting any absent field.

result.description: What every database says about one domain.

backlinks.description: The registered domains whose home page links to this one, how many and the 10 most popular. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

domains.description: Up to 10 of them, the most popular first; `[]` when none does.

total.description: How many registered domains have a home page that links to this domain.

cap_reached.description: On every answer to a key on a paid plan, and on no other: `false` while the answer has every field, `true` once its organization's overage cap is reached and the answer has the core fields. Lookups answered past the cap are not billed; raising or removing the cap in Billing turns it `false` again.

cohosted_domains.description: From IP Hosted Domains: the other registered domains on the domain's first IPv4 address, how many and the 10 most popular. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

domains.description: Up to 10 of them, the most popular first, the domain itself left out; `[]` when none does.

ip.description: The domain's first IPv4 address, `''` where it has none.

total.description: How many other registered domains resolve to it.

disposable.description: `{}` when `is_disposable` is false. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

first_seen.description: The first day seen in use.

dns.description: Its records in Domain DNS, up to 100 a type. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

last_seen.description: The last day the snapshot saw it.
The last day the snapshot saw it.

domain.description: The domain, lowercase and in punycode.

hosting.description: The network announcing each address in `dns.a` and then `dns.aaaa`, from IP ASN; `[]` where it resolves to none. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

items.description: An address the domain resolves to and the network announcing it.

asn.description: The network announcing it, as an address lookup's `asn`; every member empty where IP ASN holds none.
The AS announcing the address, 0 where none does.

country.description: The country its registry assigned it to.

prefix.description: The announced prefix covering the address.

type.description: The kind of network it runs. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

ip.description: One address the domain resolves to.

ip_ranges.description: The organization's IP ranges, from Domain IP Ranges. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

ranges.description: The first 1000, IPv4 before IPv6, the largest first.

redirects_to.description: Where its home page redirects, when that is how it was reached.

is_disposable.description: In Disposable Domain. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

is_registered.description: In Domain List: a registered domain.

redirects.description: The registered domains whose home page redirects to this one, how many and the 10 most popular. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

domains.description: Up to 10 of them, the most popular first; `[]` when none does.

total.description: How many registered domains have a home page that redirects to this domain.

trial_expired.description: On every answer to a key on the free plan, and on no other: `false` while its organization's lookups of the UTC day answer every field, `true` once those are used up and the answer has the core fields.

web.description: What our crawl last read of the domain's own home page, every member empty where it holds none. On a paid plan or a free key's full answers.

last_seen.description: The day it was last read, empty when the crawl holds no page.

links.description: The external hosts the home page links to.

hosts.description: Up to 10 of them; `[]` when it links to none.

total.description: How many external hosts the home page links to.

url.description: The URL of the home page read.

title: Look up a domain
